correctness.rationale: For nonzero rank-one X, all allowable Y=t adjX; two zero-coordinate spaces and mixed rank-one pairs partition Z, giving cardinality 3q⁴−2q². Additive character orthogonality evaluates the rank-one transform S(C)=(q^{4−rank C}−2q²+1)/(q−1), i.e. (q−1)(q+1)², q²−q−1, −(q+1) in ranks 0,1,2. Substitution gives F=q²[q²1_{A=0}+q²1_{B=0}−1+N1+(q+1)N0]; vanishes exactly for nonzero A,B with N0=0,N1=1. Each pencil corresponds to a line in P³, rank-one matrix loci form Segre hyperbolic quadric with (q+1)² points, (q+1)²q²/2 proper secants, (q+1)²(q−1) nongenerator tangents, and 2(q+1) generators. Ordered endpoint counts and (q−1)² lifts give the formula; generators contribute only at q=2 as 36 extra zeros. Independent exhaustive determinant-pencil criterion totals: q2=126, q3=3072, q5=161280.
